project_type: Python FastAPI backend + React TypeScript frontend football analytics platform (MENSIONE)
build_system: pytest for testing, uvicorn for dev server
test_framework: pytest with 931 existing tests (baseline must not break)
verification_instructions: Run pytest after each FEAT to ensure no regressions. All 931 existing tests must pass.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None - all code is hand-written, no generated files
environment_constraints: DevelopmentProvider must remain deterministic. No external API calls in tests. Never break backward compatibility of existing prediction API.
contribution_requirements: Per AGENTS.md: (1) Always inspect files before editing. (2) Never delete working code without justification. (3) Work in small verifiable steps. (4) Run tests after each step. (5) Never claim 'implemented' without verification. (6) Keep dev/mock data clearly labeled. (7) Never present mock data as real. (8) Never invent statistics. (9) AI Analyst only explains, never generates predictions. (10) Backend: Python+FastAPI+Pydantic+SQLAlchemy. (11) Frontend: React+TypeScript+Vite. (12) AI: Only Ollama (qwen3-coder:30b at http://127.0.0.1:11434). (13) No OpenAI/Gemini/Claude. (14) Code in English, UI in Turkish. (15) Modular architecture. (16) Tests for critical logic. (17) Fix errors during verification. (18) Follow PROJECT_SPEC.md phases. (19) Update docs/PROGRESS.md after completion.
key_patterns: Models implement PredictionModel interface returning ModelPrediction|ModelAvailability. Ensemble uses ModelPredictionInput. Calibration returns CalibrationMetrics. Confidence uses ConfidenceComponents. Markets derive from score distributions. PredictionService coordinates everything.
directory_structure: backend/app/prediction/ contains all model implementations. backend/app/features/ contains feature engineering. backend/app/domain/ contains domain models (Match, Team, Prediction, AnalysisContext). backend/app/api/v1/endpoints/ contains FastAPI routes. backend/tests/ contains pytest tests.
